_comment: Per-clip ingest config for single-goal.mov — the human knowledge the precompute pipeline (api/scripts/precompute.py) needs to turn a raw clip into a replayable cache. `source` resolves clip -> .mov relative to this manifest (so canned.py stays unchanged). `sampling` MUST match the hero program's sample_frames args (3500-5000ms @ 8fps -> stride 125) so detect keys align with op_sample_frames. `pins` carry the hand-verified jersey number for the hero #10 and a `match` (frame_ts_ms + nearest_box) that the pipeline resolves to a minted det_id AFTER detect runs, renaming it to the semantic det_id (p_messi). `events` derive their scorer_det from that same pin resolution (NOT an independent literal): scorer_pin names the pin whose resolved det_id becomes events[].scorer_det. `evidence_frames` declares the exact still filenames EvidencePanel.tsx hardcodes (goal-4000.jpg / scorer-4625.jpg) so the frontend stays unchanged.

pins.note: Hand-verified. Azure Read misreads the stylized WC numeral (22 -> 77); gpt-4o vision pending TPM quota. The 10 is human-legible and pinned for the hero query (disclosed in the demo).
